pulse.text: **The ranking books turned on OpenAI within hours of GPT-6 Astra shipping.** Polymarket's end-of-2026 best-model market cut OpenAI to **15% from 24%**, the September leg pushed Anthropic back up to **80% from 77%**, and OpenAI-declares-AGI-before-2027 slid a third straight time to **22%**, unwinding the launch spike from 28% entirely — a clean reversal of the drift toward OpenAI over the last two sweeps, after Artificial Analysis scored Astra **61 on the Intelligence Index**, level with GPT-5.6 Sol and Grok 4.6 and five behind Claude Fable 5.1's 66. Anthropic still holds year-end at 65% with Fable 5.1 on top and Meta's Muse Spark 1.3 third at 62; nothing new shipped in the last twelve hours, with Astra beginning its staged rollout Sep 4 to Daybreak cybersecurity testers before ChatGPT paid tiers, the API and AWS follow within days. The business story is **Nvidia's $12.93B agreement to buy Hugging Face** — its second-largest acquisition ever, covering a hub used by 18 million developers, closing in H1 2027 pending regulators — while CNBC reports early-stage AI valuations bracing for a shakeout as venture money gets pickier. Watch Grok 4.7, which Musk has dated **Sep 12** as a 2.1T-parameter pre-train with no model card yet published, and Gemini 3.5 Pro, whose September leg fell to 13% from 18% while Oct 31 held at 69% for a fifteenth straight sweep.
